decisions.reason: The compact dumper with rotating skip extends the firm's established construction machinery range, so its in-house R&D and engineering experience let it interpret early results and refine the product.
The articulated construction dumper builds directly on existing vehicle know-how and has its own website presence, giving high absorptive capacity to learn from and improve it.

The mine rescue vehicle lies far from the established offer, which raises the risk of dropping it, but the firm's underground vehicle experience and own R&D give it enough related knowledge to keep developing it for now.
The compact telescopic loader fits the firm's lifting and construction equipment expertise, so existing knowledge and R&D support assimilation and improvement.
